name: NGC 7479, SN 2009jf field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7479, a barred spiral galaxy that hosted supernova SN 2009jf, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2009jfhost-hubble
story: In the barred spiral NGC 7479, a massive star that had lost its outer layers exploded as the Type Ib supernova SN 2009jf. It went off close to a young star cluster, in a crowded region where new stars are still forming.

claims.text: SN 2009jf is a Type Ib supernova
SN 2009jf is a stripped-envelope core-collapse supernova (its massive progenitor had lost its outer layers)
The host of SN 2009jf is NGC 7479, a barred spiral galaxy
SN 2009jf in NGC 7479, type Ib, discovered 2009 Sept. 27.33 UT, at 23 04 52.98 +12 19 59.5
SN 2009jf is a type Ib in NGC 7479 found by LOSS
It occurred close to a young cluster, in a crowded environment with ongoing star formation
